body.x: Gemphones(gemphones.com), a maker of fashionable premium consumer headphones and earphones, unveiled earphones that can also be used as fashion accessories at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Each Gemphones includes a 10mm audio driver in an enclosed earphone cavity. Premium materials like agate gemstones and nylon fabric were used to make the look of Gemphones, adding luxury to everyday life. The silicon earbuds provide the ultimate softness to the ear and the fit is secure when it is snapped around the user's neck.
